parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence; the old sodomy law is repealed and its historic use (1990s soliciting charges) is dated and not trans-targeted. No documented police sweeps, facility bans, birth-sex placement rules, or trans-specific violence data; the one prison datum records trans inmates with no assaults. Visitor-facing scene operates (bars, pride with large crowds). The negatives are mostly resident-facing or climate signals: surgery-gated legal gender recognition, employment-law gaps, a media code grouping homosexuality with paedophilia (axis-K hostility signal), and documented social friction (toilet-conversion backlash, conservative youth attitudes). Border/screening treatment of mismatched documents and custody placement are open questions, not exposures — light deductions. Per rule 13, a decriminalised, institutionally functional jurisdiction with documented friction but no known trans-facing restriction sits in the reduced-risk band, a step below acceptance-with-protections exemplars, near 0.75-C but with somewhat colder official media/social climate.
